scene.note: A dry stone-lined stream channel with trees along the banks.

findings.question: channel_form
findings.evidence: downstream photo, center: the channel has steep stone walls and a flat sandy bed

findings.question: bottom_type
findings.evidence: downstream photo, bed: the dry channel bed consists of natural sand and dirt

findings.question: bank_type
findings.evidence: downstream photo, both banks: channel banks are built from stacked stones without visible concrete mortar

findings.question: habitats
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel bed: the channel is dry and lacks in-stream aquatic habitats

findings.question: natural_debris
findings.evidence: downstream photo, bed: no accumulations of leaves, fallen branches, or fallen trees are visible in the channel

findings.question: water_flow
findings.evidence: downstream photo, bed: there is no water present in the channel

findings.question: water_aspect
findings.evidence: downstream photo: the stream channel is completely dry

findings.question: water_withdrawal
findings.evidence: downstream photo: no water withdrawal pipes, pumps, or intakes are visible

findings.question: barriers

findings.question: draining_pipes

findings.question: sewage_discharge
findings.evidence: downstream photo: no sewage pipes or discharges are visible
